title: Email triage: production vs. full body
summary: 36 made-up emails, each classified 2 times per variant by Claude Haiku through the dashboard's own classify.llm_verdicts. Before: the first 600 characters of each body, as the dashboard sends today. After: the first 4,000 characters.
legend: Calendar entries that shouldn't exist: 0 before, 0 after (across all repeats). Rates count only the cases where a field applies: dates caught is over emails that need a calendar entry.

triage.text: work-invite-ats-long (before): The deciding text ends at character 1113, but the classifier only sends the first 600, so the model never saw it.
work-invite-ats-relative (before): The deciding text ends at character 933, but the classifier only sends the first 600, so the model never saw it.
work-screen-ats-long (before): The deciding text ends at character 798, but the classifier only sends the first 600, so the model never saw it.

work-assessment-deadline (before): The deadline is two days out, and the instructions put non-urgent matters at important and reserve super for action today, so the classifier's important is a reasonable reading of the gold's urgent flag.

fin-overdue (before): The instructions say to extract hard personal deadlines, and the gold itself marks the event as optional, so extracting a 'pay today' deadline from a non-bulk sender should not count as wrong.
